skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Guides an AI coding assistant through a written implementation plan using critical review, task batches, verification, and review checkpoints.
skill.summary: Execute written implementation plans in reviewed batches with verification checkpoints.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no semantic evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, unsafe tooling, or business-logic abuse.

content.value_statement: Long implementation plans can lose structure during a coding session. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through plan review, batch execution, verification, and checkpoint reporting.
actual_capabilities: Guides the assistant to read and critique a plan before starting work.
Organizes planned work into batches, defaulting to the first three tasks.
Tracks task status while each planned step is executed and verified.
Requires checkpoint reports with implemented work and verification output.
Defines stop conditions for blockers, unclear instructions, and repeated verification failures.
Directs final completion through a branch-finishing workflow when all tasks pass.
limitations: Requires a written implementation plan with clear tasks.
Does not create missing implementation details beyond the source plan.
Does not replace project-specific tests or human review.
Needs clarification when dependencies, permissions, or success criteria are missing.

use_cases.title: Structured Plan Execution
use_cases.description: Turn a reviewed implementation plan into sequenced coding work with status tracking and checkpoint reports.

use_cases.title: Review-Gated Delivery
use_cases.description: Keep an assistant working in small batches while preserving opportunities for architectural feedback.

use_cases.title: Session Handoff Control
use_cases.description: Restart work from a written plan in a new AI coding session without losing execution discipline.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute this plan in batches. First read the plan, identify any concerns, then start with the first three tasks: [plan path].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for a prepared implementation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Run Checkpointed Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans workflow for [plan path]. After each batch, report completed work, verification results, blockers, and questions before continuing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow when checkpoints must be explicit.

prompt_templates.title: Review Before Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [plan path] against the current repository before implementation. Raise architectural concerns first, then execute safe batches with tests after each task.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for plans that may need technical validation.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Final Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Coordinate a multi-phase implementation from [plan path]. Maintain task status, stop on repeated verification failure, and prepare branch-completion options after all tasks pass.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for longer plans with final release preparation.

output_examples.output: The assistant reviews the plan, notes concerns, completes the first task batch, reports verification results, and waits for feedback.

output_examples.input: Continue the next batch after feedback on the API migration plan.
output_examples.output: The assistant applies requested changes, marks the next tasks in progress, runs specified checks, and reports remaining blockers.

output_examples.input: Finish all verified tasks from the release cleanup plan.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms completed tasks, summarizes verification output, and transitions to final branch-completion guidance.

best_practices: Provide a concrete plan with verification steps before starting.
Review each checkpoint report before authorizing the next batch.
Keep success criteria and stop conditions visible during execution.
anti_patterns: Using the skill without a written plan.
Ignoring failed verification to continue the batch.
Expanding scope between checkpoints without updating the plan.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an AI coding assistant through a written implementation plan using review, batches, verification, and checkpoint reports.

faq.question: Does it write code by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides a workflow. Actual code changes depend on the plan, repository, and active assistant tools.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when you already have a written implementation plan and want controlled execution with review points.

faq.question: How does it handle blockers?
faq.answer: It tells the assistant to stop and ask when instructions are unclear, dependencies are missing, or verification repeatedly fails.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to publish?
faq.answer: The source is prompt-only and static analysis found no suspicious patterns. Generated work still needs normal testing and review.
